Congressman Al Green, Congresswoman Lateefah Simon, and Congresswoman Bonnie Watson Coleman Lead Effort Demanding HUD Protect Fair Housing Program | Congressman Al Green Skip to main content Congressman Al Green, Congresswoman Lateefah Simon, and Congresswoman Bonnie Watson Coleman Lead Effort Demanding HUD Protect Fair Housing Program September 2, 2026 Press Release (Washington, D.C.)  — On Tuesday, September 1, 2026, Congressman Al Green,  along with Congresswoman Lateefah Simon  and Congresswoman Bonnie Watson Coleman ,   sent a letter to U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Secretary Scott Turner, raising serious concerns about recent actions that threaten the Fair Housing Initiatives Program (FHIP) and the local fair housing organizations that serve communities across the nation. A copy of the letter can be accessed by clicking here . The lawmakers expressed concern that HUD’s proposed funding changes threaten local fair housing organizations, which handle more than 74 percent of housing discrimination complaints nationwide. Following a federal district court order blocking the changes, the lawmakers are calling on Secretary Turner to comply with the court’s order, rescind HUD’s FY 2025 and FY 2026 FHIP funding notices, and ensure nonprofit fair housing organizations remain eligible for funding. "The Fair Housing Initiatives Program was created by Congress to protect Americans from housing discrimination and ensure that vulnerable communities have access to safe, stable, and equitable housing. The Administration’s repeated attempts to circumvent Congress and dismantle basic civil rights protections are unacceptable," said Congresswoman Lateefah Simon . "I am proud to help lead this effort alongside Congressman Al Green and Congresswoman Bonnie Watson Coleman to hold this administration accountable for its unlawful implementation of this program and to stand firmly with the organizations and nonprofits doing the essential, on-the-ground work to combat housing discrimination in communities across the country." “From day one, the Trump administration has tried to reshape HUD from an agency that makes housing fairer and mor

Congressman Al Green Files H.Res.1486, to Impeach President Donald John Trump for High Crimes and Misdemeanors | Congressman Al Green Skip to main content Congressman Al Green Files H.Res.1486, to Impeach President Donald John Trump for High Crimes and Misdemeanors August 24, 2026 Press Release (Washington, D.C.)  — On Monday, August 24, 2026, Congressman Al Green filed H.Res.1486, to impeach President Donald John Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors. The resolution states that President Trump abused his presidential powers by allowing U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to operate without accountability, assault civilians, and cover up killings, including those of Renée Good, Alex Pretti, Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, and Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero. Following the filing of H.Res.1486, Congressman Green sent a communiqué to President Trump formally notifying him of the filing. The full articles of impeachment are available by clicking  here . Congressman Green’s letter to President Trump is also accessible for the public to read by clicking  here .

Congressman Al Green to Join State Rep. Christina Morales and Houstonians for Justice Regarding His Letter to President Trump on the Articles of Impeachment for High Crimes and Misdemeanors | Congressman Al Green Skip to main content Congressman Al Green to Join State Rep. Christina Morales and Houstonians for Justice Regarding His Letter to President Trump on the Articles of Impeachment for High Crimes and Misdemeanors August 27, 2026 Press Release ( Houston, Texas ) — On Friday, August 28, 2026, Congressman Al Green will join State Rep. Christina Morales and Houstonians for Justice  for a press conference concerning ICE-related deaths around the nation, including the death of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston, Texas. Congressman Green will share his communiqué to President Donald John Trump as well as H.Res.1486, articles of impeachment filed against the president for high crimes and misdemeanors. He will also discuss the impeachment process going forward. President Trump needs to be held responsible for his operation of United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and United States Customs and Border Protection (CBP) as unaccountable, quota-driven paramilitary forces.  Congressman Green is extending an invitation to all federal, state, county, and city elected officials to attend and stand with the community in support of accountability and justice. A copy of the communiqué to President Trump can be accessed online  here , and the articles of impeachment are available by clicking  here . Congressman Al Green stated, “I thank State Rep. Christina Morales   and Houstonians for Justice , including Johnny Mata, Cesar Espinosa, and Dr. Sergio Lira,   for inviting me to discuss the letter I sent to President Trump and the articles of impeachment I filed. President Trump has empowered ICE and CBP agents to act with secrecy and impunity, placing constitutional rights and lives in jeopardy.” Click here to watch the YouTube Live Stream of the press conference at 10:30 a.m. CT.
